title: Everyone's posting zero-asset shader masterpieces. Mine is a ball that hits dice, cards, and all manner of nonsense. It's 0.14 MB and I can't stop playing it
author: thegreatredbeard
selftext:
Every zero-asset post on here seems to be a raymarched (AI tells me this is a word? I thought it was *raytraced*) cathedral with volumetric fog. Those posts are great. This is not one of them.

This is [Kitbash](https://kitbash.phoenixstrategies.ai/)!, a one-thumb ricochet roguelike. You fire one ball and it bounces off chess pieces, poker cards, dice, pinball bumpers and the ingredients of a burger. At one point a raccoon brings you a bag of things. There are no image, sound or font files. Every pixel and every bloop is drawn and synthesized in code, so the whole game is a 0.14 MB download. It's plain JavaScript with no framework and no dependencies: WebGL2 shaders for the graphics and Web Audio synthesis for every sound, all built into one HTML file + a png icon I generated after the fact.

**What the AI did**: Fable 5.2 one-shot the first version from four screenshots of my phone's games folder and a three-paragraph prompt. I posted that version and the full prompt on r/ClaudeAI the other day: [Post](https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1xw7lnk/i_asked_fable_52_to_mash_up_my_favorite_mobile/) (has original prompt)

**What I did**: ... kept prompting for structured expansion to increase replayability and steering the output. It's now 48 rounds, 59 pieces in 9 kits, 111 "sticker" upgrades and 12 bosses. It also has a balance harness where bots play the real game code thousands of times and report which items are overpowered so I can see what mechanics' adjustments we should make etc.

It will not win any shader awards. It might eat your lunch break.

Play it free, no login, on your phone or in the browser: [kitbash.phoenixstrategies.ai](http://kitbash.phoenixstrategies.ai)  
*-- The original one-shot is still in there under VERSIONS if you want to see the delta between that and my very fancy human-led improvements*

If you want to help me test, come say hi on [Discord](https://discord.gg/C2jYNGmj67). I'm after bug reports, "this felt unfair" and "this item is broken" or any general thoughts about what you liked and didn't like.
